The Dow lost 653 points Friday and still won the week.
Friday, Oct 23: Dow 52,215.16 (-652.82, -1.2%), S&P 500 7,623.68 (-0.5%), Nasdaq 25,955.34 (-0.2%).
For the week: Dow +0.4%, S&P 500 -0.5%, Nasdaq -0.7%.
In 2026 so far: S&P 500 about +11.4%, Dow about +8.6%.
